data.summary: This directory represents a date-partitioned data storage layer (dt=2026-01-31) containing CSV datasets for core e-commerce entities such as customers, orders, order items, and products. These datasets provide raw relational data tables used for downstream analytics and data warehousing.

file_insights.summary: Success marker file for partition dt=2026-01-31.
file_insights.detailed_description: Marker file indicating successful completion or status of data processing for partition dt=2026-01-31.

file_insights.name: customers.csv
file_insights.source_summary: CSV header containing customer_id, name, city, membership_tier, changed_at, event_id, is_deleted.
file_insights.detailed_description: CSV file containing customer dimension records including customer attributes, membership tiers, and CDC tracking fields.

file_insights.name: order_items.csv
file_insights.source_summary: CSV data containing order item records such as item ID 138, order ID 68, product ID 7, quantity 1, unit price 155.75, and CDC metadata.
file_insights.detailed_description: CSV file containing order item transaction details linking orders to products with quantity and pricing.

file_insights.name: orders.csv
file_insights.source_summary: CSV data containing order headers including order ID 1 and 68, customer ID, order status, ordered at timestamp, changed at timestamp, event ID, and deletion flag.
file_insights.detailed_description: CSV file storing customer order header records with order status and timestamps.
responsibilities: Track order lifecycle status and timestamps

file_insights.detailed_description: CSV file containing product catalog data including categories and pricing information.
